mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle, compressing discount rates and boosting equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns despite a sustained FEDFUNDS increase, or Rank IC < 0.05 over a 2-year window in easing periods.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden increase in the federal funds rate above 5.5% triggers a contractionary signal, raising borrowing costs and reducing equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX shows positive 20d returns when FEDFUNDS crosses above 5.5%, or the return is not significantly different from baseline (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in quarterly GDP (GDPC1) and an expansion in supply (INDPRO) indicates robust economic growth, boosting corporate earnings expectations and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20d returns are not significantly positive when both GDPC1 and INDPRO show upward momentum (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, a decline in the federal funds rate signals accommodative monetary policy, lowering discount rates and enhancing equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns are negative in late-cycle expansion despite FEDFUNDS decline, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 2-year window in such regimes.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in labor demand (PAYEMS) and economic output (GDPC1) suggests strong employment growth and corporate investment, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5d returns are not significantly positive when both PAYEMS and GDPC1 show upward trends (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate (monetary) paired with an expansion in supply (INDPRO) creates a dual signal of accommodative policy and robust production, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60d returns are not significantly positive when FEDFUNDS declines and INDPRO rises (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sudden increase in unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 4.0% signals weakening labor market conditions, reducing corporate investment and consumer confidence, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX shows positive 20d returns when UNRATE crosses above 4.0%, or the return is not statistically different from baseline (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In a contractionary regime, a sustained high federal funds rate above 5.5% signals tight monetary policy, raising borrowing costs and pressuring equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns are positive in contractionary regime despite high FEDFUNDS, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 2-year window in such regimes.
